title: Project Config
description: Per-project production limits and egress consent, loaded from projects/<slug>/project.yaml. Overrides the pipeline manifest's budget_default_usd / max_wall_time_minutes. The config is not self-attesting: its sha256 must be bound to an approval_policy decision_log entry written through the human-gate path; a run whose current digest has no matching approval is rejected. Loaded via schemas.artifacts.load_project_config_schema() / validate_project_config(). Versioned: 1.0 (single FAL egress object), 1.1 (egress list per provider + D19 qc block) and 1.2 (1.1 + D20 hero QC: qc.hero_policy_sha256 and qc.max_hero_attempts); lib.project_config normalises all three to one shape.

budget_usd_cap.description: Hard cap on paid calls for the run; a reservation that would exceed it fails preflight

default_video_endpoint.description: D4: the approved video model for every scene (default fal-ai/kling-video/o3/pro/reference-to-video — Kling o3 pro accepts human-face references; bytedance/seedance-2.5/reference-to-video rejects any human face on FAL and is only for entity-free scenes via model_override). A scene using another endpoint must carry model_override with a reason.

characters.description: Max canon characters the visual bible may build sheets for

provider_egress.description: Explicit one-time human consent that the listed content classes may leave the machine for this provider. visual_bible cannot start without it.

wayfinder_root.description: Absolute path of the story-wayfinder project directory whose wayfinder/resolved/ tickets carry look canon. Required for authored-film 1.2 projects (look_lock ingestion confines every ticket under it; symlinks rejected).

qc.description: D19 sheet QC + D20 hero QC: the judge every verdict must come from. policy_bundle_sha256 pins the SHEET bundle, hero_policy_sha256 pins the separate HERO bundle; max_attempts_per_series caps sheet attempts per series, max_hero_attempts is the total hero generation budget per entity per look. Verdicts from any other provider/model/policy bundle are not accepted. Changing any field is a config change with a new human signature.
